## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm ci`
- [ ] `npm run review`
- [ ] Tested in a synthetic scratch vault
- [ ] If a mobile UI/runtime path changed, completed the [physical-iPhone release checklist](../docs/manual-iphone-release-checklist.md), recorded the candidate/device/result, and linked the evidence below; otherwise explained why it is not applicable
- [ ] No private vault content, `data.json`, local absolute paths, patient information, credentials, or copyrighted source text is included
- [ ] `manifest.json`, `package.json`, and `versions.json` agree if the version changed

## Physical-iPhone sign-off (when required)

- Checklist result and tester:
- Device / iOS / Obsidian versions:
- Evidence or follow-up issue link:
